_note: Town life (UBullyTownLifeSubsystem). Loops + parking spots come from the game's WALKABLE ped-area meshes (python3 -m tools.importers townlife -> imported/townlife.json; tools/ue/run_import.sh --models ... --townlife copies it to Content/Imported/TownLife/). Districts within active_radius_m of the player spawn walkers_per_loop townspeople per loop (random from 'peds', only those imported on this machine: tools/ue/run_import_npc.sh --peds ...) and fill parked_fraction of the parking spots with rides from 'parked_vehicles' (Vehicles.json ids; you can get in them). -BRTownLife forces it in a harness run, -BRNoTownLife turns it off.
